physical_subject: Why does a boat drift away from the direction it points?
relationship: Ground velocity is the vector sum of boat velocity relative to water and water velocity relative to shore.
operation: Keep the boat and banks recognizable, add water-relative and shore-relative displacement arrows, then aim upstream to cancel drift.
closest_prior: objects/05-walk: harmonic mean of trip speeds
substantive_difference: This is two-dimensional frame-relative vector addition with an upstream cancellation, not averaging outbound and return speeds.
